title: ЗАКОН ЗА ДЪРЖАВНИТЕ ТАКСИ
evidence: The history line and the amendment rows carry amendments through ДВ 20/2021, and there is no repeal marker. All seven candidates repeal other acts (arbitration fee tariffs, port fee tariffs, Interior Ministry instructions and ordinances, a decree and an ordinance on state bonds) that share only the word „такси“ or „държавните“ with this title.
